doc.title: Iola Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Wilton, CT, July 17, 2011

title: Jackie & Roy recording and wrapping up
summary: Monk plays Jackie & Roy's 'Summertime' version, thanks Iola, and talks about the archive.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: That’s great. I think one of the highest compliments that can be paid to songwriters is when other people perform their music. So I just wanted to play. I’m hoping you’ve heard this.
Well I’m going to send you a copy of it. It’s just the most beautiful thing. Almost as beautiful as Louis singing it. That’s Jackie & Roy.
And I’m very appreciative of your spending your time with me today.
Well I hope that it’s helpful. You evidently have a very good archive going, huh?
We do. We’ve done 300+ interviews and we have a nice on-line presence now and it’s been a dream gig for me to meet all my musical heroes.
